# The C wrapper

There is no wrapper here any more, and that is the point: for C, the C ABI
IS the wrapper. The library, the header and the packaging live in
[`dist/ffi`](../../../ffi/), built from this workspace as the crate
`sekejap-capi` with the lib name `sekejap`, so the file on disk is
`libsekejap.{dylib,so,a}`.

| what | where |
|---|---|
| the crate | [`dist/ffi`](../../../ffi/) -- `sekejap-capi`, cdylib + staticlib |
| the header | [`dist/ffi/include/sekejap.h`](../../../ffi/include/sekejap.h), generated by cbindgen |
| the contract | [`docs/dist/C_ABI.md`](../../../../docs/dist/C_ABI.md) -- every function, its ownership, its errors, the JSON shapes, threading |
| the map from 0.16 | [`docs/dist/FFI_CONTRACT.md`](../../../../docs/dist/FFI_CONTRACT.md) -- which e1 symbol became which, or was dropped and why |
| packaging | `dist/ffi/Makefile`, `dist/ffi/sekejap.pc.in` |
| examples | [`examples/`](examples/) here, and `dist/ffi/examples/smoke.c`, which `make check` runs |

## Build and check

```sh
cargo build --release -p sekejap-capi      # libsekejap.dylib/.so and libsekejap.a
cd dist/ffi && make check                  # compiles and RUNS examples/smoke.c
cd dist/ffi && make install PREFIX=~/.local
cc app.c $(pkg-config --cflags --libs sekejap) -o app
```

## What changed from 0.16

The 0.16 header was a surface over `CoreDB`: one slug string `"collection/key"`
per row, `SekejapEngine*` as a second handle, `open_paged` as a second store.
0.17 is sekejap's own surface over the published crate
([`docs/dist/RUST_API.md`](../../../../docs/dist/RUST_API.md)): a row is
addressed by COLLECTION and KEY as two arguments, service mode is the same
`SekejapDb*` opened another way, and there is one store. The ownership rules
did not change -- opaque handles, borrowed strings in, owned strings out freed
by `sekejap_string_free`, `NULL`/`-1` sentinels, no panic across the boundary
-- and `sekejap_last_error` gained `sekejap_last_error_code`, a closed
enumeration a wrapper maps without parsing the message.

Every symbol of the 0.16 header, and what became of it, is
`docs/dist/FFI_CONTRACT.md` §8, "The 0.17 header column".

The 0.16 Rust glue and the C++ RAII header (`include/sekejap.hpp`) are on
branch `e1`: `git show e1:dist/bindings/wrappers/c/src/lib.rs`. They are not
carried here, because they are written against the 0.16 function list.
